description: This file defines the Header class in the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation. The class handles HTTP header information, including original and normalized header names and associated values. It provides methods to retrieve header names, add single or multiple values, and retrieve header values.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents an HTTP header, storing original and normalized header names along with their values. Provides methods for adding values and retrieving header information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Header instance with the original header name, normalized name, and an array of values.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a single value to the header's values array.

methods.name: addValues
methods.description: Adds one or multiple values to the header. Throws exception if input is neither string nor array.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the array of header values.
